products.title: CanvasAutoPilot
products.tagline: Chrome Extension syncs Canvas LMS assignments & deadlines to Google Calendar with smart reminders.
products.description: Never miss another quiz or submission. CanvasAutoPilot runs quietly in your browser, extracting assignment due dates, quiz time limits, and syllabus updates directly from Canvas LMS into Google Calendar and Notion with one-click webhook sync.
features: Automatic 2-way sync with Canvas LMS
Google Calendar, Apple Calendar & Notion integration
Intelligent push notifications 24h & 2h before deadlines
Grade weighting predictor and assignment score goal tracker
100% client-side privacy: no credentials leave your browser

products.title: AlgoVisualizer Pro
products.tagline: Interactive 3D algorithm visualizer with 150+ LeetCode patterns for technical interview prep.
products.description: Designed specifically for students taking Data Structures & Algorithms or preparing for FAANG SWE internships. Step forward and backward through memory graphs, recursion trees, dynamic programming tables, and Dijkstra shortest paths in real-time.
features: Visual breakdown for 150+ Blind75 & NeetCode patterns
Step-by-step call stack and memory pointer inspector
Custom input runner in Python, C++, and TypeScript
Complexity analysis calculator with asymptotic curves
Offline desktop app and local web server included

products.title: MedStudy CramOS
products.tagline: Notion workspace & spaced repetition Anki deck with 3,500+ cards for Pre-Med & MCAT review.
products.description: Built by pre-med students with 520+ MCAT scores. Includes comprehensive high-yield biology, biochemistry, organic chemistry, and psychology synthesis dashboards, clinical case trackers, and pre-configured Anki tag systems.
features: 3,500+ verified high-yield MCAT Anki flashcards
Organized high-yield formula reference sheets
Biochemistry pathway interactive flowchart in SVG & PDF
Personalized spaced-repetition study schedule generator
Full Notion template duplicate link + CSV export

products.title: Student AI Micro-SaaS Starter
products.tagline: Production-ready Next.js + FastAPI boilerplate to turn your student AI hackathon ideas into paid apps.
products.description: Stop building auth, billing, and database schemas from scratch. This starter repo includes PayPal checkout, JWT user authentication, rate limiting, and OpenAI/Gemini streaming endpoints pre-wired for student entrepreneurs.
features: Pre-configured PayPal Orders & Subscriptions webhooks
FastAPI backend with Pydantic validation & Async SQLAlchemy
Modern Next.js 15 App Router frontend with Tailwind v4
Streaming AI chat and LLM completion pipelines
One-click deploy configuration for Render and Vercel

products.title: ResearchPaper Synthesizer CLI
products.tagline: Local Python tool to summarize, cross-reference, and format 50+ arXiv/PubMed research papers.
products.description: Writing a term paper or literature review? Drop a folder of PDF papers into the terminal. ResearchPaper Synthesizer extracts methodologies, sample sizes, conclusions, and generates ready-to-paste BibTeX and comparison tables.
features: Extracts key hypotheses, datasets, and benchmark results
Outputs structured comparison tables in Markdown & Excel
Automatic citation generator for APA, MLA, and BibTeX
Runs 100% locally with open-source embeddings support
Includes CLI flags for batch export to Obsidian

products.title: ChemReaction 3D Studio
products.tagline: Interactive WebGL visualization for Organic Chemistry II reaction mechanisms and orbital overlaps.
products.description: Struggling with SN1 vs SN2, E1/E2, and stereochemistry inversions? Rotate molecules in full 3D space, scrub through transition state electron flows, and practice predicting reaction products with interactive quizzes.
features: 60+ animated Organic Chemistry reaction mechanisms
Interactive 3D orbital overlap and dipole moment views
Stereochemistry inversion (R/S) visual diagnostics
Flashcard quiz mode with randomized reactant problems
Works seamlessly on laptop, iPad, or mobile browser

products.title: GPA Guardian & Curve Predictor
products.tagline: Chrome extension calculates historical grade distributions and predicts your final syllabus curve.
products.description: Know exactly what score you need on the final to get your target grade. GPA Guardian analyzes previous year grade curves, weighted grading policies, and professor habits to forecast realistic grade boundaries.
features: Integrates directly into student portal grading tables
Scenario simulation: "What if I get 85% on the final?"
Historical curve analyzer from past semester syllabus archives
Exportable grade report PDF for academic advising
Dark mode friendly with custom school color themes

products.title: Academic Writing AI Prompt Vault
products.tagline: 250+ battle-tested prompts for academic papers, thesis defenses, peer review rebuttal, and LaTeX.
products.description: Stop getting generic AI fluff. The Academic Writing AI Prompt Vault contains finely calibrated, scholarly prompts that enforce formal academic tone, correct citation formats, argumentative rigor, and LaTeX formatting.
features: 250+ categorized prompts for Literature Reviews, Methodology & Discussion
Reviewer #2 rebuttal generator with diplomatic academic tone
LaTeX table and formula troubleshooting prompts
Plagiarism-safe paraphrasing & clarity enhancer templates
Includes 1-click import into ChatGPT, Claude, and Gemini

products.title: CI-Guardian 🛡️
products.tagline: Autonomous pre-flight quality gate chaining syntax-aware AST security scanning & test orchestration.
products.description: Stop pushing security flaws and broken tests to GitHub. CI-Guardian runs in under 10 seconds locally or in CI, scanning AST syntax trees for exposed keys and vulnerabilities while auto-generating SARIF 2.1.0 security compliance reports.
features: Sub-10s syntax-aware AST security scanning gate
Automated test runner discovery with zero configuration
SARIF 2.1.0 security compliance report export
Automated PR documentation and change-impact analyzer
Zero external dependencies runner via npx ci-guardian

products.title: Flow7 — Performance Awareness Layer
products.tagline: Mobile-first performance awareness app turning your work sessions into neutral, visual cognitive insights.
products.description: Evidence over intention. Flow7 replaces guessing where your study and coding hours went with objective visual insights. Minimalist, friction-free session tracking engineered for independent student builders and creators.
features: Objective work session logging with zero setup
Visual cognitive performance heatmaps and focus curves
Automated weekly study & work debrief summaries
Exportable project timesheets and accountability reports
Minimalist battery-efficient dark mode interface

products.title: OAUMods — Great Ife Freshman Companion
products.tagline: The open-source, mobile-first campus navigation, hostel clearance, and survival guide for university students.
products.description: The essential pocket mentor for university campus life. Interactive campus landmark atlas, step-by-step portal clearance paper chase tracker, verified shuttle/keke transit fares, hostel balloting guide, and departmental survival notes.
features: Interactive campus landmarks & lecture theatre atlas (BOOC, ODLT, Spider)
Step-by-step clearance paper chase guide with document checklists
Verified campus shuttle and tricycle transit pricing tables
Hostel balloting tips & anti-scam advisories for freshmen
Offline-ready PWA with local SQLite persistence

products.title: Schora AI School Operations & Feedback Platform
products.tagline: AI-powered school operations platform delivering automated student feedback and weekly learning briefings.
products.description: Automated assignment grading, student diagnostic feedback generation, and weekly learning progress briefings powered by IBM watsonx and Gemini. Includes multi-role portals for educators, school administrators, and students.
features: Automated assignment grading & personalized diagnostic student feedback
Weekly student growth briefing synthesizer powered by watsonx/LLMs
Teacher syllabus coverage analytics and real-time gap analysis
Multi-role access portal (Admin, Teacher, Student, Parent)
Full TypeScript + Next.js + Tailwind CSS architecture

products.title: Clasquera — Lesson Accountability & Audio Analysis
products.tagline: Classroom lecture audio recorder & automated AI lesson-plan coverage scorer for school administrators.
products.description: Record classroom lessons, automatically transcribe speech, and score how closely teaching adheres to the syllabus. Built with Next.js 16, Flutter audio capture client, and Gemini Pro audio analysis.
features: Mobile lesson audio recording client integration
Speech-to-text automated transcription pipeline
LLM syllabus coverage scoring engine (On Plan / Partial / Off Plan)
Real-time curriculum deviation diagnostics for school principals
Executive dashboard with school-wide performance charts

products.title: NIT7ER High-Performance Studio Boilerplate
products.tagline: Next.js 16 + React 19 + Tailwind v4 commercial studio foundation for high-performance web apps.
products.description: Production-tested creative technology foundation developed at NIT7ER Studio. Fluid micro-interactions, responsive dark typography, zero runtime CSS overhead, and battle-tested TypeScript architectures.
features: Next.js 16 App Router with Turbopack & React 19
Tailwind CSS v4 zero runtime stylesheet overhead
Studio-grade dark typography and fluid micro-interactions
Accessible keyboard-navigable UI components
Pre-configured Vercel production deploy recipes
